slides.heading: Shutter Priority
slides.subheading: You control motion — the camera controls depth.

slides.heading: Why It Matters
bullets: Shutter Priority locks motion style while the camera adjusts aperture.
You choose shutter speed; the camera sets aperture.
You control motion — the camera controls depth.

slides.heading: Visual Guide
slides.caption: You choose shutter speed; the camera sets aperture.

slides.heading: How To
steps: Set shutter based on motion needs.
Raise ISO if aperture maxes out.

slides.heading: Pro Tip
slides.text: Use Shutter Priority for fast-moving subjects outdoors.

slides.heading: Common Mistake
slides.text: Forgetting aperture may hit its limit and cause underexposure.
